source_fidelity.completed_example: จบโจทย์ลูกเต๋าแล้ว explicitly keeps completion of the dice exercise.
source_fidelity.viewer_topic: ลองเปลี่ยนเป็นโจทย์ของคุณเอง explicitly asks the viewer to substitute their own question/topic. คุณเอง is possessive personal reference, not a multiplication problem.
source_fidelity.concept_selection_and_before_after_chang: โดยเลือกแนวคิดที่วาดเป็นภาพก่อนและหลังได้ asks for a concept that can be depicted in before-and-after images. In this ordinary Thai construction, the paired before/after views express the source before/after change. It does not reduce the instruction to drawing two unrelated pictures.
source_fidelity.sequence: Finishing the dice exercise comes first; changing to the viewer topic is done by selecting that drawable concept. โดยเลือก makes concept selection the entry action of the new exercise, preserving the source instruction to choose it first.
source_fidelity.conditions_negation_steps_and_values: ลอง is a natural softened instruction, not a new factual condition. The noun แนวคิด naturally denotes a concept without adding a quantity; there is no numerical value, negation or proper name to alter.
source_fidelity.teaching_intent: Retains transfer from the worked dice example to a viewer-selected concept with a visible before/after comparison. It adds no promise that every concept or every AI tool can do this.

proposals.thai_register_and_readability: Natural spoken Thai. ของคุณเอง resolves the earlier possessive ambiguity; ภาพก่อนและหลัง is a natural before/after visual expression.
